features.description: Kore passes the environment's feature flags here (ADR 0077). Only platform-portal, platform-hostname-ownership, platform-shared-gateway, golden-path-template-admission, suborg-tenancy and suborg-network-policy are read: portal on, the Organization composition also owns the realm; hostname ownership on, the Organization XRD carries a zone; shared gateway and template admission on, the Service composition labels each namespace it creates (ADR 0181); suborg-tenancy on, the Organization composition creates each suborg's namespace, labels, ResourceQuota and LimitRange, and the Service composition creates no namespace (ADR 0165); suborg-network-policy on, with suborg-tenancy, the suborg NetworkPolicies and the grant policies (issue 1552); suborg-delivery-project on, with suborg-tenancy, each suborg's AppProject (issue 1553).

suborgDelivery.description: With suborg-tenancy and suborg-delivery-project on (ADR 0165, issue 1553), the Kore repository URL each suborg's Argo CD AppProject admits as its one source. Kore passes the URL the golden-path release syncs from; it is required then and the chart refuses to render the projects without it.

repoURL.description: The Kore repository's https URL, as the golden-path delivery takes it from the git origin.

platformOrganizationId.description: The platform organization's identifier, passed only while platform-hostname-ownership is on: the Organization's zone defaults to <platformOrganizationId>.<platformDomain>.

suborgNetwork.description: With suborg-tenancy and suborg-network-policy on (ADR 0165, issue 1552), the cluster's address ranges the suborg NetworkPolicies exclude from open internet egress: the pods of other suborgs and platform namespaces live in the pod range, and the Kubernetes API answers on the service range and on any recorded API address. serviceCidr is required then; the others default to the k3s pod range and to none.

serviceCidr.description: The cluster's service range, as the environment that provisions the cluster records it.

podCidr.description: The cluster's pod range. The k3s default is assumed; no environment records an override.

apiServerCidrs.description: Addresses the Kubernetes API answers on besides its service address, excluded from open internet egress. None is recorded in any environment yet.

platformInternalDomain.description: The environment's internal domain (spec #1612), passed only while platform-hostname-ownership is on: the platform domain on a one-domain platform, internal.<platformDomain> with an external Gateway. The Organization's internal zone defaults to <platformOrganizationId>.<platformInternalDomain>, and a suborg's must be <suborg>.<platformInternalDomain>.

platformDomain.description: The environment's platform domain (ADR 0042). A service host is <service>.<organization>.<platformDomain>, so with a 63-character service and the organization the whole host stays within 253 characters.
